response.sql: SELECT AVG(UnitPrice) as average_unit_price, AVG(CAST(Bytes AS DECIMAL) / Milliseconds) as average_bytes_per_millisecond FROM Track WHERE Bytes >= 10323804

assumptions.assumption: No tracks have Milliseconds = 0. If any track has Milliseconds = 0, the division would fail with a division by zero error.

alternatives.interpretation: Exclude tracks with Milliseconds = 0 to prevent division by zero errors, treating invalid duration values as missing data to ignore.
alternatives.sql: SELECT AVG(UnitPrice) as average_unit_price, AVG(CAST(Bytes AS DECIMAL) / Milliseconds) as average_bytes_per_millisecond FROM Track WHERE Bytes >= 10323804 AND Milliseconds > 0
